name: Bulk Paragraph Delete
description: Provides bulk deletion for paragraph types from the admin UI.
project_description: Bulk Paragraph Delete adds a single admin form that lets a user with the Paragraphs administration permission delete several Paragraphs types (the paragraphs_type config entities) in one operation, instead of removing them one at a time from the Paragraph types listing. The form lists every paragraph type in a tableselect; on submit it iterates the selected types, and for each one scans all field_config entities for an entity-reference (or reference-revisions) handler that lists the type in target_bundles. Types still referenced by a field are skipped with a warning that names the offending fields, so the operation cannot break configuration dependencies; unused types are deleted and a status message reports the count. It ships one form class, one route, and one action link on the Paragraph types collection page, with no configuration, permissions, schema, or plugins of its own.
